description: The 700c Kent Retro blends style and functionality for the modern commuter. Designed with an aluminum frame, this bike is lightweight, rust resistant and can withstand the rigors of daily use. Equipped with a front hand brake & rear integrated hub brake, the Retro provides reliable stopping power and responsive handling, ensuring a safe and comfortable ride every time. Its low maintenance 3 speed drivetrain is equipped with an easy to use twist shifter, allowing you to easily shift gears with the flick of your wrist. Thanks to its lightweight alloy wheels and hybrid road tires, this bike provides a smooth and efficient ride, perfect for navigating busy city streets or cruising along scenic bike paths. The deluxe padded saddle is adjustable for height, so you can customize your riding position for maximum comfort. But that's not all – the Retro comes fully equipped with a frame mounted rear rack and front and rear fenders, making it the ultimate commuter bike. You'll be able to carry your cargo with ease and arrive at your destination without mud on your clothes. Whether you're commuting to work, running errands, or just enjoying a leisurely ride, the 700c Kent Retro is the perfect companion for your cycling adventures.
